description: Header file for ProgramLinkedResources class and related link-time checks for uniforms and interface blocks in ANGLE graphics library.

classes.name: UniformLinker
classes.description: Handles link-time checks and uniform data population for shader programs.

classes.name: InterfaceBlockLinker
classes.description: Abstract base class for linking interface blocks during program link.

classes.name: UniformBlockLinker
classes.description: Links uniform interface blocks and populates uniform data structures.

classes.name: ShaderStorageBlockLinker
classes.description: Links shader storage blocks and buffer variables.

classes.name: AtomicCounterBufferLinker
classes.description: Links atomic counter buffers based on size map.

classes.name: ProgramLinkedResources
classes.description: Stores linked resources such as uniforms, interface blocks, and buffers.

classes.name: ProgramLinkedResourcesLinker
classes.description: Links interface and atomic counter resources during program link.

methods.name: link
methods.description: Performs the linking process, validating uniforms and interface blocks.

methods.name: getResults
methods.description: Retrieves linked uniforms, unused uniforms, and uniform locations.

methods.name: addShaderBlocks
methods.description: Adds shader stage interface blocks for linking.

methods.name: linkBlocks
methods.description: Links interface blocks using provided size and member info functions.

methods.name: linkResources
methods.description: Links resources such as interface blocks and buffers based on program state.
